hints.title: Leverage Strict Ordering Across All Arrays
hints.text: All three input arrays are sorted in strictly increasing order, allowing linear synchronized three-pointer scanning.

hints.title: Advance Minimum Pointer
hints.text: Whenever elements at the three pointers differ, advance the pointer or pointers currently pointing to the minimum value.

hints.title: Append Shared Matches
hints.text: When all three pointers point to identical elements, append that element to results and advance all three pointers.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Hashing all elements takes linear auxiliary space when constant auxiliary space is achievable.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simultaneous pointer traversal takes linear time proportional to the total length and zero extra space beyond output.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should implement synchronized multi-pointer scanning gracefully without off-by-one errors.
complexity.notes: Output array is naturally sorted in strictly increasing order.
